item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J03245","case1_error":"Applies all three inches of growth above the 66-inch baseline, although final height exceeds that baseline by only two inches.","case2_error":"Evaluates the correctly written expression 30 + 2 × 15 as 70 instead of 60.","reason":"Case 1 uses the wrong baseline for the increase; case 2 numerically miscalculates a correct expression.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J03246","case1_error":"Leading answer marker says 600, but the derivation and concluding answer correctly give 400 legs.","case2_error":"Gives unsupported final answer 55 after the correct formula (26 + 40 + 34) / 2, which yields 50.","reason":"Case 1 has only an answer-marker conflict, so a shared mathematical error cannot be established.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J03247","case1_error":"Treats the combined $150 earnings as earnings per man and multiplies by three again.","case2_error":"Incorrectly evaluates $14 divided by the stated $2-per-three-piece rate as two pieces; the correct result is 21 pieces.","reason":"Case 1 double-counts the workers; case 2 incorrectly evaluates the purchase-rate calculation.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J03248","case1_error":"Interprets 70% cheaper as paying 70% of the original price instead of 30%.","case2_error":"Returns the $80 price per pair instead of the requested $480 total price of six pairs.","reason":"Case 1 models the discount incorrectly; case 2 correctly calculates a unit price but answers the wrong requested quantity.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J03249","case1_error":"Evaluates 48 − 17 − 10 as 11 instead of 21, understating the remaining inventory and profit.","case2_error":"States the correct revenue procedure but supplies unsupported final answer 168 instead of 216, without showing calculations.","reason":"Case 1 visibly miscalculates a correct expression; case 2 supplies a wrong number without arithmetic revealing its mechanism.","judgment":"different"}]}
